verdicts.reason: The two candidates are practically identical. Both keep the centred CLAYTONI / CREATIVE AGENCY lockup, which stays readable and on brand. In both, the two illustration clusters are scaled down and pulled inward, leaving about 95px of empty navy at the far left and right edges. In the original the art reaches the edges, so here it looks shrunk rather than redesigned. The figures are also cropped awkwardly at the top and bottom. The only visible difference is a slightly different position for the small purple circle in the left cluster, which doesn't change the quality.
